comment: NO REWRITES FOR /api/*. Vercel already maps /api/who to api/who.js by file
convention. The rewrites that used to sit here pointed /api/who at the literal
path /api/who.js, which Vercel served as a STATIC FILE from the output directory
instead of invoking the function. The browser got JavaScript source with a 200,
res.json() failed to parse it, health-data.js caught the error, and every field
rendered 'No data' — which read as WHO having no figures rather than as the proxy
never being called. Adding a rewrite here again will silently break the globe.
